name: rules-storage-list-map-literals-and-slice
description: Storage Rules Test API verdicts for corpus scenario "list-map-literals-and-slice" (Coverage: list/map literals, slice [i:j], OOB slice errors). Slices on split() lists and on strings must evaluate, list literals must compare by value, and an out-of-bounds slice end must error → deny (production does not clamp).
